ocl:
context BOMItem
inv: (self.inventoryItem <> null) and (self.requiredQty mod 3 = 0)

context WorkOrder
inv: (self.plannedQuantity < 50) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed = true))

context WorkOrder
inv: (self.plannedQuantity > 2) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed = true))

context Supplier
inv: self.shipments->exists(x | x.received <> true)

context Product
inv: self.unitPrice >= 19 and self.unitPrice <= 93

context BillOfMaterials
inv: (self.items->any(x | x.requiredQty > 1) <> null) and (self.bomId.indexOf('test') >= 0)

context ProductionLine
inv: self.workOrders->any(x | x.plannedQuantity >= 1) <> null

context Shift
inv: self.startTime <> null and self.endTime <> null

context Shift
inv: self.endTime <> null implies self.startTime <> null

context BOMItem
inv: (self.name <> null) and (self.requiredQty mod 2 = 0)

context Shift
inv: self.startTime <> null implies self.endTime <> null

context DefectReport
inv: (self.qualityCheck <> null) and (self.defectId <> null)

context WorkOrder
inv: (self.plannedQuantity > 5) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed = true))

context QualityCheck
inv: (self.workOrder <> null) and (not(self.workOrder <> null))

context WorkOrder
inv: ((self.plannedQuantity >= 10) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed <> false))) and (not((self.plannedQuantity >= 10) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed <> false))))

context DefectReport
inv: (self.severity >= 5 and self.severity <= 32) and (self.severity < 5)

context WorkOrder
inv: ((self.plannedQuantity <= 50) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed = true))) and (not((self.plannedQuantity <= 50) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed = true))))

context WorkOrder
inv: ((self.plannedQuantity <= 100) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed = true))) and (self.plannedQuantity > 100)

context WorkOrder
inv: ((self.plannedQuantity >= 2) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed <> false))) and (self.plannedQuantity < 2)

context ProductionLine
inv: (self.stations->collect(x | x.machines)->flatten()->notEmpty()) and (not(self.stations->collect(x | x.machines)->flatten()->notEmpty()))

context Robot
inv: (self.isCalibrated = false) and (not(self.isCalibrated = false))

context BillOfMaterials
inv: ((self.bomId <> '') and (self.items->forAll(v | v.requiredQty < 1000))) and (not((self.bomId <> '') and (self.items->forAll(v | v.requiredQty < 1000))))

context Shift
inv: ((self.startTime <> null) = (self.endTime <> null)) and (not((self.startTime <> null) = (self.endTime <> null)))

context DefectReport
inv: (self.severity mod 2 = 0) and (not(self.severity mod 2 = 0))

context WorkOrder
inv: ((self.plannedQuantity < 1000) and (self.qualityChecks->forAll(v | v.passed <> false))) and (self.plannedQuantity > 1005)

context ProductionLine
inv: (self.workOrders->collect(x | x.qualityChecks)->size() >= 2) and (not(self.workOrders->collect(x | x.qualityChecks)->size() >= 2))
